verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents point-in-time recovery that rolls back to any moment, so an accidental drop becomes a quick cleanup (docs-23). It also documents 'time travel' that restores the database to an earlier point, backed by automated daily backups and a recovery model (docs-35, docs-31). This covers the restore half of the story, but nothing shows querying data as of a past point without rolling back, and restore appears to be database-level rather than per-table. missing for 10: query-as-of-timestamp (AS OF) reads of historical data, per-table restore of a dropped or corrupted table, details on retention window and restore granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
